cards.title: Colors Are Plant Families
cards.description: Orange roots, purple brassicas, blue beans and peas, green leaves, red fruit, mustard herbs, teal water and buildings.

cards.title: Try: Filter
cards.description: Ctrl+L, then tick the tag Needs Netting or the volunteer Priya: everything else fades.

cards.title: Try: Drag a Strand
cards.description: Ctrl+Shift+B opens Strands. Drag the tag Frost Tender onto the Chilli, or Marguerite onto a blank spot for a strand card.

cards.title: Try: Auto-arrange
cards.description: Right-click Seed Library → Auto-arrange cards: a grid, one row per color. Each group has its own options in its editor.

cards.title: Try: Sort the Pile
cards.description: Drag the plants below into a bed. Let go over a group to add a card to it.

cards.title: Try: Card List
cards.description: Ctrl+Shift+L lists every card in its groups. ⋮ → Status column shows what's Sown, Growing or Harvesting. Ctrl+P jumps to a card by name.

cards.title: Beetroot 'Boltardy'

cards.title: Kale 'Nero di Toscana'

strands.name: Priya
strands.description: Runs the Tuesday session. Looks after the brassicas and the salad bed.

strands.name: Dev
strands.description: Compost, water and anything with a spanner. Mostly Saturdays.

strands.name: Marguerite
strands.description: Keeps the seed library and the herb spiral. Knows every plant's Latin name.

strands.name: Sam
strands.description: Greenhouse and beans. Brings the children's club on Thursdays.

strands.name: North Plot
strands.description: The four raised beds by the gate.

strands.name: South Plot
strands.description: Herbs, compost and the shed, against the south wall.

strands.name: Greenhouse
strands.description: The glasshouse donated by the allotment society. Unheated.

strands.name: Orchard Corner
strands.description: Six old apple trees and the bee hotel. No fields yet: pick North Plot in Strands, then Apply to… to give it the same ones.

strands.name: Spring Sow
strands.description: Sow between March and May.

strands.name: Summer Sow
strands.description: Sow between June and August.

strands.name: Autumn Sow
strands.description: Sow or plant between September and November, to overwinter.

strands.name: Perennial
strands.description: Comes back every year: don't dig it up.

strands.name: Needs Netting
strands.description: Pigeons or butterflies will eat it: keep it under net.

strands.name: Pollinator Friendly
strands.description: Flowers bees and hoverflies visit.

strands.name: Frost Tender
strands.description: Bring it in, or fleece it, below 5 °C. Not on any card yet: drag it from Strands onto the plants that need it.

strands.name: Urgent
strands.description: Do this before anything else.

strands.name: This Week
strands.description: Should be done by Sunday.

strands.name: When Dry
strands.description: Wait for a dry day.

strands.name: Planned
strands.description: On the list, not sown yet.

strands.name: Sown
strands.description: In the ground, not up yet.

strands.name: Growing
strands.description: Up and growing.

strands.name: Harvesting
strands.description: Ready to pick.

strands.name: Resting
